此记录对应较早的稿件或审查状态，仅供查阅；请针对当前问题重新深审。.zh-Hant: 此記錄對應較早的稿件或審查狀態，僅供查閱；請針對目前問題重新深審。
此记录对应较早的稿件或审查状态，仅供查阅；请针对当前问题重新深审。.en: This record belongs to an earlier manuscript or review state and is read-only. Start a new deep review for the current finding.

下一步：独立复核双方证据.zh-Hant: 下一步：獨立複核雙方證據
下一步：独立复核双方证据.en: Next: independently assess both sides' evidence

在新的模型会话中执行复核协议。模型来源由你声明，工作台无法证明服务商或模型彼此独.zh-Hant: 在新的模型會話中執行複核協議。模型來源由你聲明，工作台無法證明服務商或模型彼此獨立。
在新的模型会话中执行复核协议。模型来源由你声明，工作台无法证明服务商或模型彼此独.en: Run the assessment protocol in a new model conversation. You declare the model source; the studio cannot establish that providers or models are independent.

请使用下方人工决定按钮处理原问题；深审建议不会自动接受、撤回或解决问题。.en: Use the human-decision buttons below to handle the original finding. Deep-review proposals do not automatically accept, withdraw or resolve findings.

已核对引文与任务绑定；论证是否成立仍需人工判断。.zh-Hant: 已核對引文與任務綁定；論證是否成立仍需人工判斷。
已核对引文与任务绑定；论证是否成立仍需人工判断。.en: Quotations and task bindings have been checked; the argument still requires human judgment.

针对这条批评，让独立辩护查找作者已有的回答，再由另一轮复核指出哪些问题仍成立。适.zh-Hant: 針對這條批評，讓獨立辯護查找作者已有的回答，再由另一輪複核指出哪些問題仍成立。適用於學術論證和文書中的關鍵問題。
针对这条批评，让独立辩护查找作者已有的回答，再由另一轮复核指出哪些问题仍成立。适.en: For this criticism, ask an independent defense to find the author's existing answers, then assess which objections survive. Use it for consequential issues in academic arguments and documents.

每一步都由你导出协议并导入模型响应，不会自动上传稿件。请在新的模型会话中执行，保.zh-Hant: 每一步都由你匯出協議並匯入模型回應，不會自動上傳稿件。請在新的模型會話中執行，保留完整回應綁定欄位。
每一步都由你导出协议并导入模型响应，不会自动上传稿件。请在新的模型会话中执行，保.en: Export each protocol and import its model response yourself; the manuscript is not uploaded automatically. Use a new model conversation and preserve all response-binding fields.

请填写本轮模型来源和模型/版本，再生成任务。.zh-Hant: 請填寫本輪模型來源和模型／版本，再生成任務。
请填写本轮模型来源和模型/版本，再生成任务。.en: Enter the model source and model/version for this stage before preparing the task.

原响应和拒绝原因已保存，可修正后重试.en: The original response and rejection reason were saved. Correct the response and try again.

找不到对应的对抗深审 session.en: The requested deep-review session was not found.

请选择当前审查中的 Finding.zh-Hant: 請選擇目前審查中的問題
请选择当前审查中的 Finding.en: Select a finding from the current review.

对抗深审需要已导入的独立 AI Finding；请先完成独立 AI 审查.zh-Hant: 對抗深審需要已匯入的獨立 AI 問題；請先完成獨立 AI 審查
对抗深审需要已导入的独立 AI Finding；请先完成独立 AI 审查.en: Deep review requires an imported independent AI finding. Complete an independent AI review first.

继承 Finding 的原始 critic 协议快照不一致.en: The original review protocol snapshot for this carried-forward finding does not match.

restart 必须是布尔值.en: The restart option must be a Boolean.

对抗深审已过期：当前文档、IR、上下文、轮次或 Finding 已改变.zh-Hant: 對抗深審已過期：目前稿件、論證結構、上下文、輪次或問題已改變
对抗深审已过期：当前文档、IR、上下文、轮次或 Finding 已改变.en: This deep review is stale because the manuscript, argument structure, context, round or finding changed.

请先导入独立辩护结果，再生成证据复核请求.zh-Hant: 請先匯入獨立辯護結果，再生成證據複核任務
请先导入独立辩护结果，再生成证据复核请求.en: Import the independent defense before preparing an evidence assessment.

证据复核请求已生成，不能改写其 provider/model.zh-Hant: 證據複核任務已生成，不能改寫模型來源及名稱；如需更換，請重新開始深審
证据复核请求已生成，不能改写其 provider/model.en: The assessment task already exists and its model declaration cannot be changed. Restart deep review to use another model.

请求不属于当前对抗深审 session.zh-Hant: 任務不屬於目前對抗深審記錄
请求不属于当前对抗深审 session.en: This request does not belong to the current deep-review session.

对抗深审响应含无效 Unicode.zh-Hant: 對抗深審回應包含無效字元
对抗深审响应含无效 Unicode.en: The deep-review response contains invalid Unicode.

对抗深审响应必须是文本且不超过 1 MiB.zh-Hant: 對抗深審回應必須是文字且不超過 1 MiB
对抗深审响应必须是文本且不超过 1 MiB.en: The deep-review response must be text and at most 1 MiB.

该阶段已接受响应，不能覆盖；需要再次深审时请创建新 session.zh-Hant: 此階段已接受回應，不能覆寫；如需再次深審，請重新開始
该阶段已接受响应，不能覆盖；需要再次深审时请创建新 session.en: This stage already has an accepted response and cannot be overwritten. Restart deep review to try again.

Unsupported adversarial response contrac.zh-Hant: 無法讀取此版本的深審回應協議
Unsupported adversarial response contrac.en: This deep-review response contract version is not supported.

Unknown adversarial stage.en: This deep-review stage is not recognized.

context_evidence requires 1 to 64 source.zh-Hant: 請提供 1 至 64 段原文引文

context_evidence quote is not an exact e.zh-Hant: 引文與目前稿件中對應段落的原文不一致，請核對段落編號及引文
context_evidence quote is not an exact e.en: The quotation does not exactly match its current source block. Check the block identifier and quotation.

context_evidence role is invalid.zh-Hant: 引文的證據角色無效，請使用協議列出的值
context_evidence role is invalid.en: The evidence role is invalid. Use a value listed in the protocol.

context_evidence repeats an excerpt.zh-Hant: 證據清單包含重複引文，請移除重複項
context_evidence repeats an excerpt.en: The evidence list repeats an excerpt. Remove the duplicate.

Defense evidence_id must be unique D1, D.zh-Hant: 辯護證據編號必須依 D1、D2 等格式填寫且不得重複
Defense evidence_id must be unique D1, D.en: Defense evidence identifiers must use D1, D2, and so on, without duplicates.

Adversarial response must be nonempty an.zh-Hant: 深審回應不能為空，且不得超過 1 MiB
Adversarial response must be nonempty an.en: The deep-review response must not be empty or exceed 1 MiB.

Numeric values are not part of the adver.zh-Hant: 深審回應協議不接受此數值格式
Numeric values are not part of the adver.en: This numeric format is not allowed by the deep-review response contract.

Unknown adversarial assessment dispositi.zh-Hant: 複核建議類型無效，請使用協議列出的值
Unknown adversarial assessment dispositi.en: The assessment disposition is invalid. Use a value listed in the protocol.

A withdrawn objection must not prescribe.zh-Hant: 建議撤回批評時，剩餘問題及最小修改欄位必須留空
A withdrawn objection must not prescribe.en: When recommending withdrawal, leave the remaining issue and minimal repair fields empty.

Assessment must reference unique actual.zh-Hant: 複核必須引用已存在且不重複的辯護證據編號
Assessment must reference unique actual.en: The assessment must reference existing, unique defense evidence identifiers.

这些问题已不在当前裁决队列。旧批评、辩护及复核仍可查阅，不能导入新响应或跳转到当.zh-Hant: 這些問題已不在目前裁決佇列。舊批評、辯護及複核仍可查閱，不能匯入新回應或跳轉到目前稿件。
这些问题已不在当前裁决队列。旧批评、辩护及复核仍可查阅，不能导入新响应或跳转到当.en: These findings are no longer in the current decision queue. Their criticism, defense and assessment remain available to read; new responses and links into the current manuscript are disabled.
